$comment: The design scale of cmux NEXT webviews: spacing, control heights, icon sizes, radii, the glass levels (chrome, popover, menu, chip: each fixes the tint, the blur radius and saturation and the hairline edge; every web backdrop-filter names one, webviews/scripts/check-glass-levels.ts), the two elevations and the colour roles (leo-workspace design/grid.md, tokens.md, glass.md). webviews/scripts/pages/gen-design-scale.mjs writes the --ds-* block of webviews/src/pages/shared/desktop.css, the Tailwind theme every Tailwind entry imports (webviews/src/ui/theme.generated.css: p-3, rounded-md, text-body, bg-hover, shadow-elevation-2 resolve to these) and the TypeScript list the gallery's token sheet renders (webviews/src/ui/designTokens.generated.ts). It also reads schemas/type-scale/type-scale.json and schemas/motion-scale/motion-scale.json for the type and motion utilities. Colour roles are never literals: each names the variable the host derives from the active terminal theme (WebTheme.swift, theme/appTheme.ts), with a system-colour fallback for a page with no host yet. `bun run check:design-scale` fails when a copy drifts.

spacing.$comment: Tailwind's spacing unit is the grid base (--grid-base, 4 px times the interface scale): p-1 is 4, p-3 is 12, gap-6 is 24. The named steps are the scale tokens.md names.

controls.name: row
controls.for: compact rows, menu rows, default buttons

icons.for: status marks, chevrons, spinners, close marks, dots
menu row icons and marks inline with text

radii.name: sm
radii.for: a row highlight inside a 4 px inset

namedRadii.name: card
namedRadii.for: today's card radius; grid.md moves it to 12 after a gallery comparison

namedRadii.name: composer
namedRadii.for: today's composer radius; grid.md moves it to 12 after a gallery comparison

glass.name: chrome
glass.for: chrome docked on the window: panes, the sidebar, bars, rails, side tabs, sticky headers and the minimap

glass.name: popover
glass.for: floating surfaces over dense text: popovers, hover cards and link cards, the composer, Session Info, the running tray, viewers and sheets (artTint over art or a see-through window)

glass.name: menu
glass.for: menus, context menus, pickers and a select's menu over a dense settings row (design/settings.md, Glass)

glass.name: chip
glass.for: small glass on one line: tooltips, the find pill and chips; the tint is the host's --cmux-tooltip-tint (TooltipSurface.swift), this percentage of the popup surface before the host speaks

glass.name: lens
glass.for: a mode, not a level: while the lens draws the wallpaper behind the glass, every level takes this tint and frost

glass.name: fisheye
glass.for: a mode, not a level: the Jump to latest fisheye (design/glass.md): the bend stays, the frost runs after it

elevation.for: popovers, menus, the palette, hover cards, the composer, sheets and find bars

colors.name: surface
colors.for: the page and pane surface, opaque

colors.name: elevated
colors.for: menus, popovers and sheets under Reduce Transparency

colors.name: faint
colors.for: tertiary text, placeholders and quiet glyphs

colors.name: selection
colors.for: a selected row or the checked segment

colors.name: focus
colors.for: the keyboard focus ring (desktop.css: the host's ring at 48%)

colors.name: accent
colors.for: the theme accent: the text colour unless the theme names a hue

colors.name: on-accent
colors.for: text and glyphs on the accent
